candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment `betLimit = amount;` so calls to AdjustBetAmounts no longer change betLimit.
Replace the assignment with `betLimit += amount;` so betLimit accumulates instead of being set to amount.
Change the access check to `require(msg.sender != owner)` so the owner is blocked and AdjustBetAmounts reverts for the owner.
Change the access check to `require(true)` so anyone can call AdjustBetAmounts and change betLimit.
Replace 'difficulty = amount;' with 'difficulty = amount + 1;' so difficulty is set one higher than requested.
Delete the assignment 'difficulty = amount;' so the call no longer updates the difficulty state.
Invert the ownership check to 'require(msg.sender != owner);' so only non-owners can execute AdjustDifficulty.
Delete the require statement so the onlyOwner modifier imposes no restriction, letting anyone adjust the difficulty.
Set openToPublic to false instead of true, so the contract never opens and wager()/play()/donate() always revert.
Toggle openToPublic instead of setting it true, so calling it from an already-open state closes the contract again.
Invert the ownership check so onlyOwner reverts for the owner, meaning the owner can never open the contract.
Remove the ownership requirement so any address can call OpenToThePublic and open the contract before the owner does.
